'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine (2022–present)|Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] confirms that it will provide [[Ukraine]] with [[depleted uranium]] armour-piercing shells, alongside its [[Challenger 2]] [[main battle tank]]s, saying that there is a "low risk" of radiation contamination. [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says Russia would be "forced to react" to the British move. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65032671 (BBC News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65032671 (BBC News)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[Somali National Army]] and pro-[[Federal Government of Somalia|government]] [[militant]]s kill 30 [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[jihadist]]s and injure many others while defending a [[military base]] in the south of the country. [https://english.news.cn/20230321/8391460236ce4a238be2135d4643bdbc/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[2018–2023 Haitian crisis]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports that 187 people have been killed in a wave of violence in [[Haiti]] in the past eleven days during clashes between [[gang|gangs]]. Since the beginning of the year, 531 people have been murdered in the country. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-gang-violence-killed-31eaed96031c7bbc6b3c03ab925d2860 (AP)] [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20230321-un-gang-related-violence-has-killed-more-than-530-in-haiti-this-year (France24)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[List of national monuments of the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] of the [[United States]] [[Joe Biden]] designates two new [[National Monument (United States)|national monuments]], [[Avi Kwa Ame]] in [[Nevada]] and [[Castner Range]] in [[Texas]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/03/21/Biden-to-create-two-new-national-monuments-in-Nevada-and-Texas (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Utah]] adopts a new [[flag of Utah|flag]] after the [[Governor of Utah|governor]] officializes it. It will come into official use in March of 2024. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2023/03/25/utah-new-flag-vexillology/ (The Washington Post)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Badakhshan earthquake]]
**An [[earthquake]] strikes [[Afghanistan]]'s [[Badakhshan Province]], killing at least 30 people and injuring over 300. 20 deaths are in neighboring [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65034776 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022–2023 mpox outbreak]]
**Around three new cases of [[mpox]] are discovered in [[Thailand]]. [https://www.thaipbsworld.com/three-new-monkeypox-cases-found-in-thailand/ (Thai PBS World)]
*[[Tanzania]] reports that five people have died from an outbreak of [[Marburg virus]]. The [[Ministry of Health and Social Welfare (Tanzania)|Health Ministry]] added that three others are being treated and that 161 people are being tracked by authorities, although the ministry stated that this is not of serious concern for the country. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/03/21/Tanzania-says-five-dead-in-Marburg-virus-outbreak (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Uganda]]
**The [[parliament of Uganda]] approves [[Anti-Homosexuality Bill, 2023|a bill]] with harsher provisions against homosexual relationships. The bill includes the charges of "aggravated homosexuality" and "attempted homosexuality" with sentences of up to 10 years in prison. [https://apnews.com/article/lgbtq-rights-uganda-africa-gay-rights-3b4631458cb06a5f87c4b0c68a4de434 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Astrobiology]]
**Scientists find the presence of [[uracil]], one of the components of [[RNA]], and [[vitamin B3]] in the samples from asteroid [[162173 Ryugu]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/03/21/world/ryugu-asteroid-organic-molecules-scn/index.html (CNN)]
